answer.original_source: NN, Inc. company announcement of late June 2026 (relayed by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01); the Russell index removal is reported by finance.yahoo.com without a named original source
answer.new_information: NN, Inc. (not a covered company; research scope is NVDA only) announced 47 new machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling serving NVIDIA AI racks, with 100% of the capacity said to be pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and a 2026 new-business target of US$80–90 million. The period is 2026 and the target is a company party statement, not a result. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a third-party narrative (US$485.5m/US$47.9m) and an unnamed analyst rumour (US$489.5m/US$48.3m), and the fair-value and index-removal items are context. None of these maps to an NVDA question's period or definition, so this record is background for NVDA and moves no stored argument.
